text: At the October 2026 checkout, getAllIDs tests this._deleted.has(ids[k]) before assigning ids[k]. That value is undefined, while markDeleted stores the string ID k. The pending-deletion filter therefore appears unable to omit the marked key. Check a focused test before changing the code; getCreateRecordData has a separate correct check.
title: Audit the Sync deleted-ID filter in getAllIDs
